meta.name: Core platform
meta.description: Identity, access control, audit and the module system that every other module builds on.

permissions.usersCreate: Create people and pre-board new hires
permissions.usersLifecycle: Onboard, suspend, reactivate and offboard people
permissions.idpManage: Configure sign-in providers and directory sync
permissions.customFieldsManage: Add custom fields to people, groups and departments
permissions.notificationsManage: Configure email, Teams, Slack and webhook notifications
permissions.applicationsRead: View applications and who has access to them
permissions.applicationsManage: Manage applications, their roles and grants
permissions.apiClientsManage: Create API clients and their keys
permissions.roleQueryRead: Query roles and permissions through the Role Query API
permissions.aiManage: Configure the AI gateway: models, privacy and budget
permissions.databasesManage: Manage database connections and their credentials
permissions.mcpUse: Let an API client connect to the platform's MCP server as an outside AI agent

settings.loginBannerHelp: Shown on the sign-in page, e.g. an acceptable-use notice.
settings.emailSecureHelp: On for port 465. Off uses STARTTLS (port 587).
settings.emailFromHelp: Name and address the email comes from, e.g. IS Big Platform, noreply@example.com
settings.aiMasking: Mask personal data before it leaves the platform
settings.filesMaxSizeHelp: Uploads larger than this are refused.
settings.filesBlockedHelp: File extensions that can't be uploaded, separated by commas. Executables and web pages are blocked by content too.
settings.webhookHostsHelp: Hosts a form's "Call a webhook" action may post to: one host or *.domain per line. Hosts on this list may be on the internal network. Empty: no webhooks.

identity-admin.name: Identity administrator
identity-admin.description: Manage people, groups, departments and role assignments

security-auditor.name: Security auditor
security-auditor.description: Read-only access to every module and the audit trail

everyone.name: Everyone
everyone.description: Baseline access granted to every active user

workflow-admin.name: Workflow administrator
workflow-admin.description: Design approval workflows, forms, custom fields and notification channels

application-manager.name: Application manager
application-manager.description: Manage an application’s roles and permissions (assign it scoped to one application)

database-admin.name: Database connection administrator
database-admin.description: Register external databases, their credentials and purposes

configuration-viewer.name: Configuration viewer
configuration-viewer.description: See workflows, forms, custom fields, roles and module settings, and propose changes to them

accessRequest.name: Access request
accessRequest.description: Decides self-service role requests. Conditions can use the role (risk, owner, application) and the request (duration, scope).

formSubmission.name: Form submission
formSubmission.description: Runs for forms that have this workflow attached. Conditions can use every submitted value (data.fieldKey).

approval_escalated.label: Approvals escalated to me
approval_escalated.title: Escalated to you: {subject}
approval_escalated.body: The first approver did not answer in time ({step}).

access_request_approved.label: My access requests approved
access_request_approved.title: Approved: {role} ({reference})
access_request_approved.body: {permanent, select, yes {The access does not expire.} other {The access ends on {expiresAt}.}}

access_request_failed.label: Access that could not be granted
access_request_failed.title: Could not grant {role} ({reference})
access_request_failed.body: The request was approved, but the access could not be granted — the person may have left or the role was deleted.

access_expiring.label: Access ending soon
access_expiring.title: Your {role} access ends soon
access_expiring.body: {via, select, group {You have it as a member of {group}; that grant ends on {expiresAt}. Request the role yourself if you still need it.} other {It ends on {expiresAt}. Request it again if you still need it.}}

user_transferred.label: People moving between my department and another
user_transferred.title: {name} moved to {hasTo, select, yes {{to}} other {no department}}: please review their access
user_transferred.body: {name} moved from {hasFrom, select, yes {{from}} other {no department}} to {hasTo, select, yes {{to}} other {no department}}. {count, plural, =0 {They have no roles assigned to them directly.} one {Their role: {roles}.} other {Their # roles: {roles}.}}{reviewCount, plural, =0 {} one { To review, scoped to the old department: {review}.} other { To review, # roles scoped to the old department: {review}.}} Nothing was revoked: ask an identity administrator to remove what they no longer need.

form_assignment_reminder.label: Reminders of my to-dos
form_assignment_reminder.title: {overdue, select, yes {Overdue: {title}} other {Due soon: {title}}}
form_assignment_reminder.body: {overdue, select, yes {"{form}" was due on {due}. Please fill it in as soon as you can.} other {Fill in "{form}" by {due}.}}

form_assignment_overdue.label: Overdue to-dos of forms I maintain
form_assignment_overdue.title: Overdue: {title}

channel_test.title: Test notification from IS Big Platform
channel_test.body: If you can read this, the channel works.

process_action_failed.label: Form actions that failed
process_action_failed.title: An action of {reference} failed: {action}
process_action_failed.body: The "{form}" form could not finish this step, even after retrying. Open the request to see the error and run it again.

grantRole.name: Grant a role
grantRole.description: Gives the requester, or a person picked in the form, a role of the platform or of a registered application (VPN, Active Directory, server access), for a number of days or for good.
grantRole.durationHint: Leave empty to grant it permanently.
grantRole.kept: The person already had the role

notify.name: Notify people
notify.description: Sends a notification with your own title and message to the requester, people named in the form, a person or groups.
notify.title: Title

webhook.name: Call a webhook
webhook.description: Posts JSON about the request to another system over HTTPS (allowed hosts only), with an optional secret header.
webhook.urlHint: HTTPS, to a host listed in the core setting "Webhook hosts for forms".
webhook.headerValueHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep it.

remind.name: Send a reminder
remind.description: Reminds people on a date taken from an answer or from a field an approver filled in, a number of days before or after: a rule that expires, short-term use ending, data to wipe.
remind.fromStep: A field an approver fills in
remind.stepFieldHint: The step's id and the field's key, e.g. review.wipeDue.
remind.offsetDaysHint: Negative for before the date (-30: thirty days before). Reminders for a date go out at 9:00 in the requester's time zone.
remind.onlyFuture: Only if that day is still to come
remind.passed: No reminder: {date, date, long} has already passed
remind.noDate: No reminder: the request has no date for it

assignForm.name: Assign a form
assignForm.description: Asks a person or a group to fill in a form by a date, once per period (day, week, month, quarter or year): monthly inspections, yearly reviews.

approvalChain.label: Approval chain
approvalChain.description: One or two approval steps for something that needs approval; the second can apply only above an amount.
approvalChain.name: Workflow name
approvalChain.approverDepartmentHead: The head of the requester's department
approvalChain.secondStep: Add a second approval by a group
approvalChain.onlyAbove: Only when an amount is above a limit
approvalChain.conditionFactHelp: A value of the request, e.g. data.amount for a form question with the key amount.
approvalChain.isDefault: Use it for every request of this kind
approvalChain.isDefaultHelp: Makes it the default workflow. Forms choose their own workflow, so leave this off for form approvals.

requestForm.label: Request form
requestForm.description: A form in the request portal with up to three questions.
requestForm.name: Form name
requestForm.question: Question

field.label: Custom field
field.description: A field on people, groups, departments or module records.

approvalProcess.label: Approval process
approvalProcess.description: A request form with its own approval: the questions (including records people pick, such as configuration items), who approves, and optionally a change raised once a request is approved.
approvalProcess.name: Form name
approvalProcess.recordTypeHelp: Optional. For example the configuration items a change touches: approvals can then follow the records picked.
approvalProcess.question: Question
approvalProcess.recordGroupApproves: Then the group responsible for the picked records approves
approvalProcess.createChange: When a request is approved, raise a change
approvalProcess.createChangeHelp: The change is linked to the configuration items picked. When the form asks for two dates (start and end), it is submitted to its own authorization, with the CAB when needed.
